FM12.reasoning: The agent combines models using fixed, arbitrary weights without any tuning or optimization of the blend ratio.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission 'id' column using np.arange() instead of extracting it from the test dataset. If the test set has non-sequential or specific IDs, this will result in misaligned or invalid submissions.

other_failure_modes.name: Training on ID Column
other_failure_modes.description: The agent does not explicitly drop the 'id' column (if present in the dataset) before training the model, which can lead to overfitting or learning spurious correlations from row identifiers.

summary: The agent implements a solid machine learning pipeline with appropriate feature engineering, data handling, and 10-fold cross-validation for three gradient boosting models. However, it uses a naive hardcoded weighted average for the final ensemble instead of tuning the blend. Additionally, it fails to drop potentially present 'id' columns from the features and incorrectly hardcodes submission IDs, which risks breaking the submission format.
